title: Fragment five: putting it down
subtitle: A holo recording, three hundred years old
author: dubbed to tape by Lt. Shepard
extra: One of six. His name is in this one.

lines.text: DUBBED FROM HOLO: FRAGMENT FIVE OF SIX
Outside now. A porch. A dog asleep on his feet.
Whatever I was. The power to make things and unmake them. All that.
I made myself a man, and then I made it stick.
It was the hardest thing I have ever done.
Harder than copying the valley, or the river.
I had to close my hand and keep it closed. For good.
I needed a name, then. Men have names. I had never had one.
Tucker Gold. It is a stupid name. She chose it.
She said I looked like I'd been left out in the sun.
He laughs, properly, and the dog wakes up and glares.
We grew old together. That was all the plan there was, and it worked.
My back went, and then my eyes. I was glad of all of it.
She never asked what happened to her the first time.
I never told her. I do not know if that was right.
I think she knew. She would look at the river, sometimes.
Then she would go back to the bees.
